## Topics

- Matrices and 2D indexing [r, c]
- Lists: heterogeneous data and nested indexing (list$name, list[[i]])
- Data Frames & Tibbles: creation, column access, and structure (str(), summary())
- Importing data: CSV (readr::read_csv) and Excel (readxl::read_excel)
- Exporting cleaned data
